title: Typed error class for every failure
prompt: Create `src/errors.ts` that exports `class ApiError extends Error` with a public readonly `status: number` (the HTTP status), and `src/health.ts` that exports `async function getHealthStatus(client: Client<paths>): Promise<"ok" | "degraded">` using `GET /health`. It throws an `ApiError` with the HTTP status for every response that is not OK, also when the response has no body.
